propositions: When commit history is rewritten while preserving the ticket tree, compacted ledger entries retain their pre-rewrite commit SHAs, causing the verifier to misclassify authentic events as key-not-valid-at-era.
The verifier must treat ledger commit_sha as a cache and resolve ledger positions against the current history, preferring the newly resolved commit SHA over the recorded pre-rewrite SHA.
When a ledger position cannot be resolved in current history, the verifier must fall back to the recorded commit SHA as a fail-closed fallback.
Live-event commit resolution, ledger schema, event bytes, and null-commit recovery behavior must remain unchanged.
A real-Git history-rewrite regression must demonstrate that signed events retain their verdict after all commit SHAs change due to history rewrite.
